summary: The verified-handle-to-VFS rule, ACL-before-DB behavior, case-wide fail-closed catalog, cleanup quarantine/tombstone sequence, CSRF boundary, and same-account threat model are coherent. One mismatch remains: the acceptance matrix requires a bad catalog HMAC case, but the design specifies catalog ACL/owner/file-ID/format/Sync validation without defining catalog MAC format or key custody.

findings.title: Catalog HMAC negative case has no matching format/key contract
findings.evidence: §3 defines catalog ACL/owner/file-ID/format/Sync validation and fail-closed behavior, but does not define an authenticated catalog format or key. §6 requires a malformed/bad-HMAC catalog negative case before case DB access.
findings.risk: The implementation/test contract is ambiguous; introducing an undocumented catalog key could create an unreviewed secret-storage boundary. Under the declared trusted-account threat model, this is a specification consistency gap rather than a demonstrated boundary bypass.
findings.required_revision: Either specify catalog MAC schema/canonicalization and supervisor-protected key establishment/storage/recovery, or remove the bad-HMAC negative case and retain ACL/identity/strict-format/Sync corruption cases.

control_dispositions.acl_before_receipt_or_db: specified for every receipt path and file open; runtime not verified
control_dispositions.catalog_global_fail_closed: specified for ACL/owner/file identity/format/Sync anomalies; HMAC case lacks specification
control_dispositions.cleanup_quarantine_tombstone: coherent ordering; quarantine durable before delete, tombstone after complete removal and parent sync
control_dispositions.csrf_loopback_boundary: specified and internally consistent with Bearer/no-cookie/no-CORS model
control_dispositions.same_account_threat_boundary: explicitly excludes trusted-account/admin/kernel/host compromise; receipt-first claim is scoped accordingly
control_dispositions.privacy_lifecycle: per-case keys, request_trace_id separation, synthetic data and retention rules remain specified

remaining_conditions: Resolve PSK-SEC12-01 before implementation of the case catalog integrity tests.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No SQLite VFS, OS permissions, catalog, browser requests, keys, database, or recovery path was inspected at runtime.
This review does not approve implementation, production deployment, real student data, or classroom readiness.
